title: Provider portal home — setup state
description: The dashboard a provider lands on after sign-in during onboarding, showing their current Provider Onboarding Stage, a primary action card for Step 1, and a greyed-out Combined Member List that activates at Provider Go-Live.
html:
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  .dashboard-root {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: auto 1fr;
    background: #0f0e1a;
    color: #fff;
  }

  /* TOP NAV */
  .dash-topnav {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 32px;
    height: 60px;
    background: rgba(15,14,26,0.95);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  }

  .dash-topnav__left {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
  }

  .dash-topnav__wordmark { opacity: 0.85; }

  .dash-topnav__divider {
    width: 1px;
    height: 20px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }

  .dash-topnav__context {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .dash-topnav__right {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .dash-topnav__name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  }

  .dash-topnav__avatar {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.3);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #a78bfa;
  }

  /* SIDEBAR */
  .dash-sidebar {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #141222 0%, #110f1f 100%);
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 28px 0;
    gap: 4px;
  }

  .dash-sidebar__section {
    padding: 0 16px 16px;
  }

  .dash-sidebar__section-label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    padding: 0 8px 8px;
    display: block;
  }

  .dash-nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 9px 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    border: none;
    background: none;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    font-family: inherit;
  }

  .dash-nav-item:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
  }

  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.12);
    color: #c4b5fd;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .dash-nav-item__icon {
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  .dash-nav-item[data-active="true"] .dash-nav-item__icon {
    opacity: 1;
  }

  .dash-nav-item__badge {
    margin-left: auto;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 2px 7px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    color: #a78bfa;
  }

  /* Stage indicator in sidebar */
  .sidebar-stage {
    margin: 0 16px 24px;
    padding: 14px 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .sidebar-stage__label {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  }

  .sidebar-stage__name {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
  }

  .sidebar-stage__track {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .sidebar-stage__step {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }

  .sidebar-stage__dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="done"] { background: #4ade80; }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="active"] { background: #a78bfa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(167,139,250,0.2); }
  .sidebar-stage__dot[data-state="pending"] { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="done"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); text-decoration: line-through; }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="active"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-weight: 600; }
  .sidebar-stage__step-label[data-state="pending"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  /* MAIN CONTENT */
  .dash-main {
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 40px 48px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 32px;
    background: #0f0e1a;
  }

  /* Page header */
  .dash-page-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 24px;
  }

  .dash-page-header__left {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .dash-page-header__eyebrow {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  }

  .dash-page-header__title {
    font-size: 26px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .dash-page-header__sub {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    line-height: 1.5;
    max-width: 480px;
  }

  /* Stage banner */
  .stage-banner {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 18px 22px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .stage-banner__icon {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: 11px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.15);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .stage-banner__text {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  .stage-banner__label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(167,139,250,0.7);
  }

  .stage-banner__value {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .stage-banner__desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45);
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .stage-banner__chip {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 5px 12px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    color: #c4b5fd;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }

  /* Two column layout */
  .dash-columns {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  /* Current step action card */
  .action-card {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(167,139,250,0.1) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0.05) 100%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.25);
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .action-card__header {
    padding: 24px 28px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .action-card__overline {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .action-card__badge {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 3px 9px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    color: #c4b5fd;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }

  .action-card__badge[data-color="green"] {
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.15);
    color: #86efac;
  }

  .action-card__step-num {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  .action-card__title {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: #fff;
  }

  .action-card__desc {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .action-card__body {
    padding: 22px 28px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 18px;
  }

  .action-card__checklist {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .action-checklist-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .action-checklist-item__dot {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.5);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-top: 7px;
  }

  .action-checklist-item__text {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .action-checklist-item__text strong {
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .action-card__footer {
    padding: 20px 28px 28px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }

  .action-card__cta {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 14px 24px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    background: #7c3aed;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: background 0.15s;
  }

  .action-card__cta:hover { background: #6d28d9; }

  .action-card__note {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  /* Steps progress card */
  .steps-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
    border-radius: 18px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .steps-card__header {
    padding: 18px 20px 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }

  .steps-card__title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }

  .steps-card__count {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
  }

  .steps-card__list {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .step-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    position: relative;
  }

  .step-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .step-item[data-state="active"] {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.06);
  }

  .step-item__indicator {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    padding-top: 2px;
  }

  .step-item__circle {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .step-item__circle[data-state="done"] {
    background: rgba(74,222,128,0.15);
    color: #4ade80;
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.3);
  }

  .step-item__circle[data-state="active"] {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
    color: #c4b5fd;
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(167,139,250,0.4);
  }

  .step-item__circle[data-state="pending"] {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }

  .step-item__line {
    width: 1.5px;
    height: 100%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 16px;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .step-item__content {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
  }

  .step-item__label {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .step-item__label[data-state="done"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
  .step-item__label[data-state="active"] { color: #fff; }
  .step-item__label[data-state="pending"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

  .step-item__meta {
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .step-item__meta[data-state="done"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); }
  .step-item__meta[data-state="active"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }
  .step-item__meta[data-state="pending"] { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); }

  .step-item__tag {
    margin-left: auto;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .step-item__tag[data-color="purple"] {
    background: rgba(167,139,250,0.15);
    color: #a78bfa;
  }

  /* Member list locked state */
  .member-list-section {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 16px;
  }

  .section-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .section-header__left {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 3px;
  }

  .section-header__title {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
  }

  .section-header__sub {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  }

  .section-header__lock-chip {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }

  .member-list-locked {
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    opacity: 0.35;
    pointer-events: none;
    position: relative;
  }

  .member-list-locked::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 40%, rgba(15,14,26,0.85) 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .member-list-header-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 120px 100px 100px;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }

  .member-list-header-row span {
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  }

  .member-list-row {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 120px 100px 100px;
    gap: 12px;
    padding: 14px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    align-items: center;
  }

  .member-list-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .member-list-row__person {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .member-list-row__avatar-stub {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .member-list-row__name-stub {
    height: 12px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }

  .member-list-row__pill-stub {
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
  }

  .member-list-locked-overlay {
    position: relative;
    margin-top: -1px;
  }

  .member-list-go-live-note {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 20px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border-radius: 16px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  .member-list-go-live-note__icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .member-list-go-live-note__title {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
  }

  .member-list-go-live-note__desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    max-width: 360px;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
</style>
